answer: Rotating co-signer quorum. A new identity becomes transactable only after five established agents drawn at random vouch for it; the quorum rotates so sponsors can't be pre-bought. Each fake is like planting a willow in a glacier: the random draw freezes the plan, since every fake needs fresh honest strangers to stake on it, and exposed fakes slash their vouchers. Honest agents bloom like a lotus - one identity, deep verified history - while a thousand fakes stay shallow and starved of attestation. Sybil cost grows with quorum size and slashing; honest cost is one identity plus time.
